artisanDockerSocket.title: Docker: socket address used to run Artisan in a container (unix:// path)

artisanDockerContainer.title: Docker: container ID that runs Artisan
artisanDockerContainer.description: Leave empty and use Laravel: Choose Docker Target… to pick one per project.

artisanDockerWorkdir.title: Docker: project folder inside the container (absolute path, mounted from this project)

diagnostics.title: Report views, config keys and translation keys that don't exist

reportMissingRoutes.title: Also report route names that aren't defined in routes/ (packages add routes the plugin can't see)

locale.title: Main locale: its translations are the ones shown and navigated to

publicDirectory.title: Public directory that asset() paths start from (project-relative)

controllersNamespace.title: Namespace that 'Name@action' controller strings resolve in

reportUnknownComponents.title: Report <x-…> Blade components that have no file or class

reportUnknownLivewire.title: Report <livewire:…> components that have no class or view

reportUnknownLivewireDirectives.title: Report @livewire('…') components that have no class or view

reportUnknownLivewireMethods.title: Report unknown wire:click and wire:submit methods
reportUnknownLivewireMethods.description: Methods that the component class of a livewire/ view does not have.

modelDirectories.title: Extra model directories (project-relative, comma-separated), for models outside app/Models

reportMissingResourceMethods.title: Report Route::resource() controllers that lack resource methods

reportUnknownRouteControllers.title: Report controllers and controller methods named in routes/ that the project does not have

reportUnknownInertiaPages.title: Report Inertia pages that have no file under resources/js/Pages

reportUnknownFactories.title: Report Model::factory() calls of models without a factory

checkEloquent.title: Check Eloquent models and queries
checkEloquent.description: Report mass assignment of unguarded models, unscheduled prunable models and orderBy() on date columns that latest() or oldest() replace

checkFunctions.title: Report env() calls outside the config directory
checkFunctions.description: env() returns null once the configuration is cached.

checkSecurity.title: Report request data passed unfiltered to create(), update() or fill() and variables in raw SQL

enumValueInspection.title: Report where() values that the column's enum cast does not have

upgradeInspection.title: Show code that breaks on the next Laravel major version

missingTranslationInspection.title: Report translation keys that some locales have and others lack

routeHints.title: Show route and controller hints in the editor
routeHints.description: Inline hints next to route names and controller actions, from the project index.

scopeAttributeIntentions.title: Offer to convert query scopes to the #[Scope] attribute (Laravel 12.6+)
scopeAttributeIntentions.description: Shown only when composer.lock pins Laravel 12.6 or newer.

languageDirectory.title: Application language directory (project-relative; empty uses framework defaults)

massAssignmentExceptions.title: Mass assignment inspection exceptions by model class
massAssignmentExceptions.description: JSON object mapping fully qualified model classes to field-name arrays. Use ["*"] to ignore a model.
